aboutUs.address: Cross Gate, 7th Floor, 1-101-1 Sakuragicho, Naka-ku, Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan
aboutUs.mainBusiness: An online-based platform for the sale and export of used vehicles, auto parts, and machinery. We connect Japanese suppliers with global buyers, ensuring quality, transparency, and reliability.
aboutUs.registeredInJapan: Under the Yokohama Legal Affairs Bureau
aboutUs.overview: Founded by a team with over 40 years of customer service experience, Artisbay Lite Inc. blends traditional expertise with modern technology to deliver a seamless, trustworthy automotive export experience. We serve both individual and business clients worldwide, offering tailored solutions for every need.

howToBuy.intro: Buying from Artisbay Lite is simple and transparent. We support both single vehicle and bulk/container purchases, with flexible shipping and payment options.

steps.title: Order
details: Browse our website to find your desired vehicle or part.
Check the price for your destination directly on the product page.
Click 'Request a Quote' to start your order.
Our sales team will contact you to confirm details and answer any questions.

steps.title: Payment
details: After receiving your invoice, pay securely via bank transfer or PayPal.
We confirm your payment and begin processing your order.
Bank fees are the customer's responsibility. Please send a payment slip for faster confirmation.

steps.title: Shipment
details: We arrange shipping via your preferred method: LCL (Less than Container Load), FCL (Full Container Load), or RoRo (Roll-on/Roll-off).
Shipping schedule and tracking details are provided after payment.
We prepare all export documents, including Bill of Lading (B/L), export certificates, and invoices.
Documents are sent via DHL or can be picked up locally, depending on your region.

steps.title: Delivery
details: Your vehicle or goods arrive at the destination port.
Clear customs with a local agent (we can recommend trusted partners).
Inspect your vehicle before driving: check brakes, oil, coolant, and tires.
Enjoy your purchase! Our support team is available for any post-delivery questions.

shippingOptions: LCL (Less than Container Load): Share container space with other buyers for cost savings.
FCL (Full Container Load): For bulk orders or multiple vehicles/parts.
RoRo (Roll-on/Roll-off): Vehicles are driven onto ships; ideal for single car shipments to certain ports.
notes: Shipping costs depend on destination, vehicle size, and method.
We help estimate taxes and duties in your country.
Insurance and inspection services are available on request.

points: Over 40 years of customer service experience in the automotive industry.
High-quality used vehicles and parts, thoroughly inspected and graded.
Customized services for every need, including auction selection, dismantling, packing, and shipping.
Transparent process with full documentation and photo/video evidence at each stage.
Environmental responsibility: promoting sustainable practices and responsible recycling.
Direct access to Japanese auctions and suppliers.
No hidden fees—full cost breakdown provided upfront.

faq.question: How do I pay for my order?
faq.answer: You can pay via bank transfer or PayPal. Bank fees are the customer's responsibility. Please send us a payment slip for faster confirmation.

faq.question: How do I receive my documents?
faq.answer: Documents will be sent via DHL or can be picked up locally, depending on your region. We provide tracking information for all shipments.

faq.question: What services does Artisbay Lite offer?
faq.answer: We offer vehicle and parts export, business consulting, renewable energy solutions, bulk procurement, and export training.

faq.question: Can I buy a single vehicle or do I need to order a full container?
faq.answer: You can purchase a single vehicle—no need to fill a whole container. We offer LCL and RoRo shipping for single units, with flexible options based on your needs and destination.

faq.question: What is RoRo shipping?
faq.answer: RoRo (Roll-on/Roll-off) shipping means vehicles are driven onto specialized ships and secured for transport. It's often the most cost-effective method for single vehicles, depending on the destination port.

faq.question: Do you provide support after delivery?
faq.answer: Yes! Our support team is available for any post-delivery questions or issues. We also offer guidance on customs clearance and local regulations.

faq.question: Are inspections and insurance available?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer pre-shipment inspections and marine insurance upon request. Please ask our team for details and pricing.

faq.question: How do I contact Artisbay Lite for help?
faq.answer: You can chat with us on the website, email support@artisbay.com, or use the contact form on our site. Our team responds promptly to all inquiries.
